name: saas-authentication
context: Design a complete authentication flow including login, signup, and password reset screens for a SaaS application. The audience is new and returning users who need frictionless account access with proper security indicators. Target platforms: mobile (primary) and desktop. The flow must support email/password, social OAuth providers, and magic link options while maintaining trust through clear error handling and security feedback.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for form labels, headings, and helper/error text
Apply color.rules.json feedback tokens for validation (error, success, info)
Auth card must be centered with max-width and proper spacing from layout.rules.json
Password fields must include show/hide toggle with proper ARIA state
Social login buttons must follow each provider brand guidelines for icon usage
Error messages must be specific (not generic) and positioned below the relevant field
Comply with Quality_Gate: no password rules hidden until error, clear state transitions

outputCriteria.format: Authentication flow spec with login, signup, and password-reset views, inline validation, social auth buttons, and transition choreography
qualityChecks: Form validation shows inline errors immediately below relevant inputs
Password strength indicator uses feedback token gradient (error to success)
Social auth buttons are visually grouped and separated from email form
View transitions (login to signup) use Motion_Library page-transition presets
Loading state on submit button prevents double-submission
accessibilityRequirements: All inputs have visible labels (not placeholder-only)
Error messages linked to inputs via aria-describedby with aria-invalid=true
Password visibility toggle announces state change to assistive technology
Form submission errors summarized at top with links to offending fields
Auto-focus set to first input on page load for efficient keyboard flow

examples.description: Login view with email/password form, social login options, and error state
examples.output:
Page: AuthPage
  Layout: flex(align=center, justify=center, min-height=100vh)
  bg: var(--color-surface-secondary)
  Children:
    - Organism: AuthCard(max-width: 420px, width=100%)
        bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
        radius: var(--radius-xl)
        shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
        padding: var(--space-2xl)
        Children:
          - Atom: Logo(asset=logo.mark, height=32px, margin-bottom=space.xl)
          - Atom: Heading(level=h1, token=typography.heading.lg, text='Sign in')
          - Molecule: AuthForm
              - Atom: Input(type=email, label='Email', autoComplete='email', required)
              - Molecule: PasswordInput
                  - Atom: Input(type=password, label='Password', autoComplete='current-password')
                  - Atom: IconButton(icon=eye, ariaLabel='Show password', aria-pressed=false)
              - Atom: TextLink(text='Forgot password?', color=color.action.primary)
              - Atom: Button(variant=primary, label='Sign in', width=full, type=submit)
          - Atom: Divider(text='or', color=color.border.subtle)
          - Molecule: SocialAuth
              - Atom: Button(variant=outline, icon=google, label='Continue with Google')
              - Atom: Button(variant=outline, icon=github, label='Continue with GitHub')
          - Molecule: AuthFooter
              - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, text='No account?')
              - Atom: TextLink(text='Sign up', color=color.action.primary)
acceptanceCriteria: Auth card centered with shadow and radius tokens from Token_System
Password field includes visibility toggle with ARIA pressed state
Social auth separated by divider with proper visual grouping
All form inputs use visible labels with autocomplete attributes
Action links use action.primary color token
